description: Gate sequencer driven by a cellular automaton: a drawn seed pattern runs Conway's rules one generation per clock, and a cell coming to life fires the trigger groups that mark it

params.text: Sets how many clocks pass before the pattern is reloaded from the seed, 1 to 64
Selects that trigger group for editing, so clicking in the grid marks which cells fire it; pressing it again returns to play mode

inputs.text: A rising edge runs one generation of the automaton; it reads high above 2V and low below 0.1V
A rising edge reloads the pattern from the seed and restarts the count

outputs.text: A 10ms 10V trigger, fired whenever a cell marked for that group comes to life in the new generation

notes: the grid is drawn on by dragging across it: with no trigger group selected the drag edits the seed pattern, and with a group selected it marks which cells fire that group
the module comes up with a seed pattern and trigger markings already in place, so it plays as soon as a clock is patched into STEP

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
